maddeler.e:
ينسكب (form VII)
# يَنْسَكِبُ (yansakibu) /jan.sa.ki.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# يَنْسَكِبَ (yansakiba) /jan.sa.ki.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# يَنْسَكِبْ (yansakib) /jan.sa.kib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
